narrative: Compensatory damages for emotional distress, loss of religious participation, deprivation of family association, and economic loss. Punitive damages against Rojo and Noguchi (reckless disregard for constitutional rights). Declaratory judgment. Injunctive relief against Macomber prohibiting enforcement of unwritten parole travel policies and requiring individualized assessment of all religious travel requests. Attorney's fees under 42 U.S.C. §1988.
risk: Favorable risk profile: unwritten policy violates strict scrutiny (Sherbert v. Verner); defendants acted with reckless disregard; disparate treatment of religious vs. secular travel supports First Amendment claim; Mathews v. Eldridge balancing favors procedural protections (notice, opportunity to be heard); timing of denial shows bad faith. Macomber sued in official capacity only — no individual immunity defenses applicable to prospective relief.
